data.description:
@inheritdoc

The data to show as markers in the map.

The data should be an array objects, where each object must include at least two fields that can be mapped to
`latitude` and `longitude` for a map marker to be rendered. By default, the `latitude` and `longitude` fields are
expected to be named "latitude" and "longitude", but these can be overridden using #latitude and
#longitude. Additional data can be included and referenced by field name as a tooltip header, tooltip
sub-header, and/or additional fields to render in a tooltip that can be rendered upon click of a map marker
(see #tooltipConfig):

In the example below, #latitude and #longitude would also need to be set to "someLatitudeField" and
"someLongitudeField".

```json
[{
  someLatitudeField: !double
  someLongitudeField: !double
  ...additionalFields
}]
```

dynamicData.description: The {@link Genai.Agent.DynamicData} containing the data to be visualized

sourceType.description:
Only required if an #evalMetricsSpec or #evalSpec is provided. This target type will used for
those calls to populate the data to be visualized.

evalMetricsSpec.description:
Optional spec passed to the UI to generate the visualization from an `evalMetrics` call rather than from
#data. One of #data, #evalMetricsSpec, or #evalSpec must be set, with `data`
always taking precedence. The visualization generated by the `evalMetricsSpec` will always be a Line Chart.

evalSpec.description:
Optional spec passed to the UI to generate the visualization from an `evaluate` call rather than from #data.
One of #data, #evalMetricsSpec, or #evalSpec must be set, with `data` always taking
precedence.

title.description: An optional title to render above the visualization.

visualizationConfiguration.description:
A JSON representation of a {@link UiSdlComponent} that will be rendered as part of a
{@link UiSdlDynamicComponentRenderer}.  The specific JSON will be set in #generateUiComponent.

toolId.description:
The {@link Genai.Agent.Tool} that generated the spec to get the visualization.
This is used when {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.MultiSourceSynthesizer} is used to answer a query and {@link Genai.Query.Result#childResults} generates spec to render a visualization.

sourceRelation.description: The {@link Genai.Query.ResultToSourceRelation} created for the spec that this visualization is generated on.

latitude.description: A reference to the column/field name in the #data that should be used as the latitude for each map marker.

longitude.description: A reference to the column/field name in the #data that should be used as the longitude for each map marker.

tooltipConfig.description: Configuration for the tooltips that render on click of each map marker

title:
Type designed to dynamically render a {@link GenAiUiSearchResultMap} as a visualization for a
{@link Genai.Query.Result}.
name: GenAiVisualizationMap
